audience: nonprofit and association staff who manage contacts, donations and memberships in CiviCRM

useCases.title: Find a contact with their donations and memberships
useCases.text: The AI finds a contact by name, email or phone and reads their contributions and memberships, with amounts, status and dates. It can list memberships that end before a date, for renewal follow-up.

useCases.title: Find large donations in a period
useCases.text: The AI lists contributions filtered by date range, minimum amount, status or financial type, newest first, and adds up the total.

useCases.title: Check event participants
useCases.text: The AI lists events, upcoming first, and the registrations of an event with status, role, registration date and fee.

useCases.title: Log a call or note on a contact
useCases.text: The AI records an activity such as a phone call or meeting with one or more contacts, or adds a note to a contact. Nothing is sent.

useCases.title: Add a contact, membership or donation
useCases.text: The AI creates a contact, gives a contact a membership, or records a donation that was paid elsewhere. No payment is taken and nothing is sent.

useCases.title: Add a contact to a group or register for an event
useCases.text: The AI adds a contact to a static group, or registers a contact for an event. It sends no confirmation email.
